To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose the MultI-Level Framework (MILE) that allows contemporary graph embedding methods scale to large graphs by repeatedly coarsening the graph into smaller graphs and applying the graph embedding methods on the smallest graph, and we demonstrate MILE can be used with several popular graph embedding methods and significantly boost the speed of graph embedding.
MILE: 1. scales graph embedding to large graphs; and 2. generates high quality node embeddings for node classification task.

MILE: 1) is an efficient and scalable framework for graph embedding that is agnostic to embedding techniques, 2) can significantly boost the speed of existing graph embedding methods, 3) often generates embeddings of better quality, and 4) can scale to a graph of 9 million nodes.
